searchText: This is related to the empty block issue. Prysm has a hard deadline for GetPayloadV6 of 300ms. When Besu only has an empty block ready (because of the disabled tx pool issue), we wait for the ongoing block that is built to see that if that one has more txs before responding to GetPayloadV6. But in those cases that took longer than those 300ms. It took around 470-500ms, so Prysm timed out and did not propose anything. I check how to improve that
